Package
Description
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.mfa
Use cases of the multi-factor framework: security events, second-factor lockout and trusted devices.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.passkeys
Use cases that manage the passkeys (WebAuthn credentials) of a user: list, rename and delete, whether the user has one (a second factor enrolment query), and the relying party settings.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.sms
Use cases of the SMS channel: phone enrolment and verification, cost-capped sending of codes and the enrolment query of the SMS second factor.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.totp
Use cases of the TOTP authenticator-app second factor and its recovery codes.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.mfa
PostgreSQL implementations of the multi-factor ports: security events, second-factor attempts and the per-user enforcement flag, over the security_events, second_factor_attempts and users tables.
